summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of tunAide AP. Backend: 13/13 pytest assertions PASS after fixing a critical 500 in POST /api/uploads caused by MongoDB ObjectId leaking into the response payload. Frontend: Full end-to-end flow verified in Expo web preview on 390x844 viewport — Onboarding -> Auth (sign in test@tunaide.com/Test123!) -> Permissions -> Scan (14 files) -> Library home (All 14, Music 5, Recordings 8, Voice Memos 3, Downloads 2, Favorites 0) -> Search 'Rahman' returns 3 results -> Category screen + select-all -> Push tab auto-opens push-config with 14 files, 292.6 MB -> Push Now -> Queue -> auto-navigates to Success ('Pushed Successfully!') -> Back to Library. Audio Detail: metadata, favorite toggle, play/pause, and 'Push to tunAide Transcribe' navigation all working. Activity: transcriptions tab shows 14 items with Complete status (all flipped after 45s per backend simulation). Profile: name/email correct, Settings switches (wifi-only, auto-retry) toggle, Sign Out returns to auth-screen. Session persists after re-login. No deprecated Expo packages detected in the tested screens. All critical testIDs present.

ui_bugs.issue: On initial activity-screen focus, `upload-history-*` rows rendered 0 while transcriptions tab correctly showed 14. May be a timing/render race with the useFocusEffect load(); on subsequent polling it should populate. Verify by refreshing or adding a loading state.

Bottom sheet confirm button intermittently reported by Playwright as 'outside viewport' on 390x844. Modal Sheet content may exceed the visible area on smaller devices — consider adding safe-area/max-height + ScrollView. Worked when clicked once, failed second attempt.

issues: 'View on Website' correctly shows informative toast because EXPO_PUBLIC_TRANSCRIBE_WEB_URL is intentionally empty — expected MOCK behavior.

action_items: (Optional) Investigate why Activity Uploads tab shows 0 rows immediately after screen focus while Transcriptions has data — likely add a lightweight loading indicator or await first load before rendering empty state.
(Optional) Make signout sheet content scrollable / clamp maxHeight so confirm button is always inside viewport on 390x667-ish devices.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /api/uploads previously returned upload_doc without stripping Mongo `_id` -> caused 500 (ValueError: ObjectId object is not iterable). Fixed by adding '_id' to the excluded keys filter. Consider a helper `strip_mongo(doc)` reused across endpoints.
server.py uses `datetime.fromisoformat(d['completes_at'])`; because completes_at is stored as ISO with tz, comparison against tz-aware `now` works. Good.
Backend does not paginate /api/uploads or /api/transcriptions (currently to_list(300)). Fine for MVP but flag for later.
get_current_user raises HTTPException(401) on both missing and expired token — good UX; message differentiates.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical flows pass; 2 minor UI observations)

seed_data_creation: Registered ephemeral users with pattern test_<hex>@example.com and uploaded synthesized WAVs (~16KB) for upload/transcription flow validation. Real seeded account test@tunaide.com used for frontend E2E.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: http://localhost:8000. Test creds: test@tunaide.com / Test123!. Pytest config at /app/backend/pytest.ini injects xdist -n; run with -o addopts='' to avoid parallel duplication of session fixtures. Note that email domain .test is rejected by pydantic EmailStr (special-use TLD) — use example.com in test emails. Transcription flip takes ~45s (TRANSCRIBE_SIM_SECONDS=45).
rca_of_issue: POST /api/uploads was returning 500 Internal Server Error because motor's `insert_one` mutates the doc in-place to include `_id: ObjectId(...)`, and the response builder only excluded `user_id` and `storage_path`. FastAPI's jsonable_encoder then failed with 'ObjectId object is not iterable'. Fix: add '_id' to the excluded keys tuple. Reproduction: authenticate, POST multipart to /api/uploads -> 500. After fix: 201 with clean upload payload.
